title: Hisuian Arcanine 042/066 R Rare Holo Pokemon Japanese Crimson Haze sv5a
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This collectible card game features the popular Pokémon character, Hisuian Arcanine, in a rare holo version. The card is from the Japanese Crimson Haze sv5a set and has a card number of 042/066 R. It is a Stage 2 card and belongs to the Pokémon TCG game.

The card is in excellent shape and comes from the reputable manufacturer, Nintendo. It is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress Hisuian Arcanine fans. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare holo card.
